title: A career across science, software and project leadership
introduction: My career has developed around projects requiring an understanding of several disciplines, organised collective work and direct contributions to the solution.

sections.title: Journey
paragraphs: After training in physics, chemistry and biophysics, I worked on molecular simulation and machine learning, built instruments and experimental platforms, and later led a digital product combining AI and XR.

sections.title: Activities alongside main roles
paragraphs: Several assignments and collaborations were carried out alongside the main positions.
items: Independent technical consultant for Vidya Health Ltd from April to November 2020: automated epifluorescence microscope under NDA, autofocus algorithm, specifications, LabVIEW development and deployment, documentation and training.
Occasional independent assignments since 2023, currently paused: prompt-engineering advice and training, classification, data analysis and Python integration.
Occasional continuation of scientific collaborations and work associated with MLLPA.

sections.title: Teaching
paragraphs: King’s College London, January to June 2023: statistical thermodynamics for approximately one hundred third-year chemistry students, with the programme and materials designed in full and teaching delivered in English.
ECPM, University of Strasbourg, 2021 to 2023: AI, machine learning, deep learning and Python for three cohorts of approximately thirty Master’s-level engineering students.
items: Five intermittent physics and chemistry teaching placements or contracts between 2008 and 2013 at lower- and upper-secondary-school level.

sections.title: Education
items: PhD in Biophysics — University of Strasbourg / Institut Charles Sadron, 2014–2017.
MSc Physics and Chemistry — Science Education, 2011–2013.

sections.title: Outside professional work
paragraphs: Music, trombone and bass, experience performing in bands and concerts, drawing, painting, a webcomic and short films.
